gem_placement: Signed GeM replaces only the global average pooling that follows each of the 5 Self_Attn modules (input: y = gamma*attn(x) + x, support and query), before prototypes and Euclidean distance. pooled = GeM_p(max(y,0)) - GeM_p(max(-y,0)); p=1 equals GAP.

eval_protocol.episode_identity: BLAKE2b digest of support+query pixels and labels, exact equality across configs
eval_protocol.note: GPU memory = torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated; GFLOPs count conv/matmul only
